When told to warn his near kindred, the Prophet called each tribe of Quraish by name, telling Bani Abd Manaf, his aunt and Fatima to buy themselves from Allah.
Mu'adh is told to invite the People of the Scripture in Yemen to the testimony, then prayer, then Zakat; there he leads Fajr reciting that Allah took Abraham as Khalil.

From Safa the Prophet warns Quraysh of a terrible punishment; Abu Lahab curses him, and the verse on Abu Lahab is revealed.
